description: This file defines the ErrorValue class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, which provides static methods for error checking functions such as isErr, isError, and isNa. These functions help determine whether a given value represents a specific spreadsheet error, supporting both scalar values and arrays.

classes.name: ErrorValue
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to evaluate spreadsheet error states.

methods.name: isErr
methods.description: Checks if the provided value (or array of values) is an error and not NaN, returning a boolean or array of booleans.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the provided value (or array of values) is a recognized error code, returning a boolean or array of booleans.

methods.name: isNa
methods.description: Checks if the provided value (or array of values) equals the NA() error, returning a boolean or array of booleans.
